140.text: This is the Shaman. Left-click on her directly to select her, or left-click on the Shaman Button on the Control Panel. Right-click when you want to deselect her.

78.text: I have created my Reincarnation Site and the settlement is nearly complete.

84.text: Your settlement is thriving, Shaman. Braves resting in Huts are one way of creating Mana. Mana gives you the power to cast spells and train Followers

85.text: Your tribe is small. Four Huts should breed enough Followers for you to attack the Dakini. Rest some Braves in your Huts and they will create Mana for your spells.

83.text: The Lightning Spell is a devastating weapon and much more powerful than Blast. It kills Enemy Followers, and sets fire to Trees and buildings.

82.text: You have received a Single Shot Landbridge spell. Use it to create a path from where your Shaman stands to the land on which it is cast. Cast it over water to create a causeway.

86.text: Shaman, you've stolen the Warrior Training Hut Plan! Build one to train Warriors ready for conquest.

87.text: Braves sent to a Warrior Training Hut become Warriors. Training uses Mana.

102.text: Now we must face the Matak Tribe. I sense many Warriors ready to stand against us. In my vision we are aided by magic from a Stone Head. There must be a way to reach it...

103.text: Use the Tornado Spell to destroy the Enemy and their buildings before they have a chance to react.

68.text: Shaman, this Stone Head will aid you faster if you command two of your Followers to worship there.

110.text: We face a great threat. The Matak are massing against us. I need the power of Lightning to defeat them, but Preachers are guarding their Vault of Knowledge.

71.text: Your Braves will not be able to handle the Enemy on their own. Build a Warrior Training Hut to train some Warriors.

72.text: The Enemy has the ability to subvert your Followers by using her Preachers. You also have this ability so use it against her.

73.text: Your forces are well trained and the Enemy is weak. Use your advantage to destroy the Enemy once and for all.

111.text: Use the Convert spell to turn Wildmen into faithful Followers.

65.text: Shaman, you have discovered the Plans for the Guard Tower. This will enable you to establish a new settlement elsewhere.

130.text: The Ancients have granted you a Boat, Shaman.

50.text: The Chumara will use the spell of Invisibility to attack us. Once again, I sense a Stone Head that contains a prize: the spell of Erode! Then, I will seize the power of Invisibility from their Vault of Knowledge.

100.text: Use the Erode spell on steep mountains to weather the rock and make the land walkable again. You can also use it to destroy enemy buildings by eroding the land beneath them.

112.text: Use the Invisibility spell on your own people and make them undetectable when entering an Enemy settlement.

51.text: Shaman, beware. You are being attacked by invisible Enemies!

57.text: I have had a terrible vision with scenes of death and destruction as our settlement sank into the sea! I must move swiftly if I am to save my tribe and wreak revenge upon our Enemies.

131.text: You have run out of time, Shaman, and your revenge has failed. The island has returned to the depths of the ocean.

58.text: Shaman, the Totem Pole across the water can give you the land you need to replenish your tribe.

59.text: Shaman, the Totem Pole in the Matak settlement has the power to grant your revenge.

60.text: Once again we must face two tribes. I shall crush the Matak, then I must deal with the greater threat of the Chumara.

147.text: Use the Hypnotise spell to convert Enemy Followers to your cause. But beware, the effects will fade with time.

0.text: For the first time we must face all three Enemy tribes. I must prepare for a mighty struggle.

1.text: I sense a new threat an attack from the skies. I must make ready for the battle to come.

148.text: The Dakini have trapped me in this magical prison and I cannot escape. I must command my Followers to free me or we are all doomed.

3.text: I sense a spell hidden somewhere in this desert land that will increase the strength of my Followers. I must find it.

66.text: Use Bloodlust to fill your tribe with a powerful fighting frenzy.

4.text: I sense a great struggle ahead. The Chumara, Dakini and Matak are massing their forces against us.

5.text: The Dakini are the mightiest of the three tribes we must face. I fear that if they are not stopped they will unleash a terrible magic upon us.

6.text: The Dakini have grown too powerful on this world. I am suspicious of allying my tribe with the Chumara, but I must protect their settlement and prevent the Dakini from destroying us all.

12.text: Use Teleport to move instantly to any location on the world.

127.text: Your allies' defences have been breached. They are under attack!

128.text: Your allies are losing their battle against the Dakini. They are desperate for your help.

129.text: The Chumara have given up all hope of survival. This is your last chance to save them.

7.text: I sense the Dakini are preparing for war. I must create more land to build on if I am to increase my forces and face them in battle.

8.text: This is a mysterious, hostile land. I sense there are many dangers that I must face before we meet the Dakini in Battle.

10.text: Well done Shaman. The Totem's Flatten spell has sealed the fault, preventing an eruption. More faults can be sealed by using this spell.

126.text: A fault has become unstable and sparked a massive volcano! There are still more faults on the world that can be fused with the correct spell.

149.text: None of my followers could accompany me to this world. I am alone and I shall need all my strength and cunning to survive.

17.text: Welcome to Populous: The Beginning. You can leave this Tutorial and return to the Main Menu by pressing the Escape key and choosing Quit to Main Menu.

141.text: Well done. You have completed the Tutorial.

49.text: Worship this Obelisk to finish the fighting section of the tutorial.

47.text: This is a Preacher. He can convert Enemy Followers to your cause. Command your Preacher to attack the Enemy Warriors. He will stop them and use his chants to convert them to your tribe. Do not disturb your Preacher while he preaches to the Enemy.

121.text: This time, the Enemy has defeated your Preacher.

48.text: Congratulations. You have turned the Enemy Warriors into loyal Followers!

45.text: This is a Warrior. He is much better at fighting than the Brave but he cannot build. Close by are some Enemy Braves. Command your Warrior to attack them.

120.text: This time the Enemy has defeated your Warrior.

46.text: Congratulations! You have defeated the Enemy. They are no match for your Warrior's sword!

43.text: Congratulations, you have defeated the Enemy Brave!

44.text: This time the Enemy has defeated your Brave.

42.text: Move your mouse pointer over your Brave and left-click to select him. Then, move your mouse pointer over the Enemy Brave and left-click to attack him.

77.text: Braves sent to a Warrior Training Hut become Warriors. Training uses Mana. Try training two Warriors.

41.text: Worship this Obelisk to finish the building section of the tutorial.

119.text: Each Hut you build increases your maximum population by three.

39.text: You haven't assigned Braves to enter your Huts. After a while, any idle Braves outside a Hut will enter it to rest without being ordered to.

37.text: When placed in Huts, Braves generate more Mana for you and breed to increase the size of your tribe. Select your Braves and left-click on the building to put them in.

36.text: Now build another Hut for your Braves to live in.

40.text: Right-click on the Hut to find out who is occupying it. Full Huts are upgraded over time, increasing their capacity to a maximum of five Followers.

35.text: You haven't assigned any Braves to build on the Plan! Nearby idle Braves will automatically build after a short while.

34.text: Now that you have placed down the Hut Plan, select your Braves and left-click on the Plan. They will start preparing the foundations and collecting wood for construction.

33.text: Move your mouse to the Buildings Panel and select the flashing Hut icon. When you move your mouse over the land, you will see that you are holding a Plan.  Move the Plan next to the other Huts and left-click to place it down. The arrow on the Plan indicates the entrance of the Hut. Rotate the Plan by pressing the Space Bar.

122.text: Now move on to the advanced tutorial. Worship at an Obelisk to go to a new section of the tutorial.

31.text: Worship this Obelisk to finish the spell casting section of the tutorial.

30.text: Congratulations! You've killed all the Braves.

28.text: You have run out of Blast spells. You'll have to wait for one to charge up again.

29.text: The last Brave is slightly out of your current spell range. However, the higher you are, the further your spells will reach. Command the Shaman to enter the Guard Tower to give you the height you need.

117.text: Select the Blast spell from the Spells Panel on the left. Move the mouse pointer over the Enemy Braves standing on the islands and left-click to blast them.

116.text: Worshipping Vaults of Knowledge will provide you with new spells and building Plans. To command the Shaman to worship the Vault of Knowledge, select her and left-click on it.

115.text: Pray at this Totem Pole to trigger a Landbridge.

113.text: Congratulations, you've destroyed the Guard Tower!

27.text: Select the Lightning Spell from the panel on the left. Move the mouse pointer over the Enemy Guard Tower on the island and left-click to fire the spell at it. The Shaman will walk into range before casting the spell.

32.text: Stone Heads grant you temporary gifts. To command the Shaman to worship this Stone Head, select her and left-click on it.

150.text: Worshipping Obelisks benefit you in a variety of ways. To command the Shaman to worship an Obelisk, select the Shaman and left-click on the Obelisk.

61.text: Left-click on the Shaman directly to select her, or left-click on the Shaman Box on the Control Panel. Right-click when you want to deselect her.

135.text: Move the mouse pointer to the edge of the screen to scroll and use the Cursor Keys to rotate.

137.text: This is the World View. Use the Cursor Keys to rotate and right-click anywhere or press Return to zoom in. You can press Return at any time to come back to the World View.

38.text: The people in this Hut are producing Mana. A full Hut breeds new Followers more quickly than an empty one.
